raw_directive: Audit and design environmental protection and green space mechanics. 1. Evaluate the logic, financing, and management of national parks, buffer zones, landscape parks, and nature reserves, including their relationship with state forests and waters. 2. Ensure compatibility with the parcel system: these zones must be able to dynamically grow, shrink, be created, or be abolished based on systemic/political decisions. 3. Design urban/recreation parks intended for human use, featuring minor infrastructure that boosts population happiness, increases access to recreation/sports, and reduces local pollution. 4. Define the strict economic and management models determining who finances, manages, and alters the borders of these parks.
